gates.requirement: Canonical lockfile byte encoding is deterministic UTF-8 with LF and no BOM.
gates.evidence: BuildGraph.lockfile_text and write_lockfile preserve the canonical bytes.

gates.requirement: Equivalent source, target, profile, and compiler inputs reproduce the same artifact identity.
gates.evidence: Independent project roots produce identical lockfile text/hash and artifact identity.

gates.requirement: A changed declared foreign-library ABI byte identity changes the artifact identity.
gates.evidence: The declared local foreign library hash and resulting artifact identity change after one ABI file byte changes.

gates.requirement: Undeclared environment changes do not affect graph or artifact identity.
gates.evidence: Changing an unrelated environment variable leaves lockfile text and artifact identity unchanged.
